modulesAndFieldsSelectNonSystemEventFiel.message:
Select non-system event fields to include in Quick Create.
                      Fields are grouped by ownership (core, participation, custom) to match field configuration.

modulesAndFieldsTheseSettingsConfigureFo.message:
These settings configure form linking eligibility (whether forms can be linked to events), not form assignment or execution.
                    Form assignment and execution belong in Work interfaces.

modulesAndFieldsTheseSettingsConfigureGe.message:
These settings configure geo requirements (whether geo tracking must be enabled), not geo tracking execution. 
                    Geo tracking execution (GPS capture, radius validation) belongs in Work interfaces.

modulesAndFieldsTheseCheckboxesConfigure.message:
These checkboxes configure field requirements (which roles must be assigned), not role assignment itself. 
                    Role assignment happens in Work interfaces when creating/editing events.
